title: Fix review findings on the disconnect bar and reconnect
body:
Fix the review findings on the Remote Session disconnect bar and reconnect (commit 6b4926d: src/remote.rs, src/terminal.rs, src/wm.rs, src/workspace.rs, src/panel.rs). A code review and a design review each refused sign-off. No new features beyond what is listed.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-remote-sessions-design.md (sections: UI > Disconnect, Persistence). Read foreman-change-control before touching the workspace snapshot format.
Blocked by: Disconnect bar, reconnect and restore-disconnected
Must fix:
1. The original prompt can be resent. remote::reconnect_argv and its AGENTS list decide "is an agent" from the program file stem only, while the rest of the app (tab icon, the at-launch reply note in add_remote_terminal) uses icons::IconKind::from_argv, which scans every token. So `foreman open --on desk -- npx @anthropic-ai/claude-code "do X"` (or `wsl claude ...`, or a wrapper) shows the Claude icon, and Enter after a drop replays the whole argv, brief included. Use ONE predicate for icon, reply note and reconnect, and fail safe: an argv that looks like an agent but has no clean resume entry relaunches the bare agent program fresh with NO arguments from the original argv. remote::AGENTS also duplicates board::AGENTS; keep one list. Fix the test that pins `python claude_tool.py` the other way.
2. No mouse path. In Session::show the `active && disconnected` branch replaces the whole normal input branch, so the bar cannot be clicked and selection, copy-on-select, the copy shortcut, the scrollback thumb and search are all dead: the user cannot copy the ssh error they are looking at. Give the bar a click target (ui.interact with an Id built from the term id, Sense::click, hover feedback) that requests the reconnect, and keep selection / copy / scroll / search alive while disconnected; block only writes to the PTY (wheel forwarding included).
3. The banner lies. WindowManager::reconnect injects "reconnected to <name>" right after spawning ssh, before any connection; with the PC off the user reads "reconnected" above an ssh error. Word it as in progress ("reconnecting to <name>...").
4. A background tab that disconnects is invisible. refresh_exit_titles now skips the exited marker for Remote Sessions and nothing replaces it; the Sessions-panel row looks like any background tab. Show a "disconnected" marker on the tab title and the panel row, cleared on reconnect.
5. A restored Remote agent tab silently comes back as a bare shell and loses its directory. Session::disconnected_remote sets an empty dispatch argv and ContentSnap::Terminal saves only the Remote name. Persist the agent program (the provider name only, never the prompt or other arguments) and the Remote directory in the snapshot, with serde default + skip_serializing_if so old files load as today and a local Terminal serializes byte-identically (pin both in tests). A restored agent tab then resumes through the one resume table and keeps its icon; an explicit --cwd directory survives a restart.
6. Enter must ignore key repeat (require !repeat) so a held Enter at the moment ssh dies cannot reconnect and then submit an empty password.
Also fix (small):
- Bar copy per state: a dropped connection, a restored never-connected Session ("Not connected to <name> - Enter to connect") and an agent ("Enter to resume claude") read differently; show the ssh exit code when it is not 0 or 255.
- paint_disconnect_bar sizes its font from the row height, so chrome text scales with terminal zoom; use the fixed size the search bar uses. It also borrows the search-bar theme tokens: keep them if no better token exists, but say so in a comment.
- The missing-Remote restore toast formats the title with {:?} (quotes, doubled backslashes) and fires once per tab; use the display name and one toast for the batch. A reconnect error must not read "t7 is gone".
- status --json reports a disconnected Remote Session as state "exited" with exit_code 0, which a consumer reads as finished. Add an additive field (skip when absent, compat test) that says it is disconnected; do not change existing fields.
- `foreman send` to a disconnected Session must be refused with a plain error instead of replying ok; an inject queued while disconnected must not be dropped silently.
- With the search bar open at disconnect, Esc must still close search before Enter means reconnect.
Not in this card (report as open, do not build): keeping the original --model / permission flags on resume; keeping scrollback across a reconnect.
Done when:
- unit tests: the wrapper argv shapes above never yield an argv containing the prompt; one predicate is shared; Enter with repeat does nothing; the snapshot round-trips the provider and directory and a local Terminal is byte-identical to before; status compat
- the input-gate test shows selection/copy still work while disconnected and nothing is written to the PTY
- existing workspace, remote, control and chat tests pass
- the final report lists the states the human should capture with build-screenshot: just disconnected focused with the ssh error above the bar; the same unfocused; restored-disconnected with an empty grid; a failed reconnect; a Win about 15 columns wide; a Win under two rows tall; a disconnected background tab in the tab strip and the Sessions panel; the missing-Remote toast
Gate: cargo test --target-dir target/agent workspace; cargo test --target-dir target/agent remote; cargo test --target-dir target/agent control
